**F02 NON-AUTHOR BOUNDED SOURCE/HANDOFF REVIEW — COMMENT / INTEGRATION CORRECTION NEEDED. Not final design/RIG or release approval.**

**Identity and examined inputs.** Reviewer `mastermindxryan` is distinct from F02 PR author `mastermindx-2`. Existing request [#6620018694](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/pull/10630#issuecomment-6620018694) anchors the changed-source scope at `6b72172aec810aa7795e5a50d4be9ca2dde5cf5b`; I also examined the one-commit source/handoff continuation at exact current head `c985c24e2558dbd4211d34e7bac2e62e50506ba3`. The PR remains Draft, base `main`. Inspected the F01 handshake, SOURCE_AND_DATA_CONTRACT, INTERACTION_STATES, NATIVE_CONTINUATION, current RETURN_F02, formal-review input/route observation, and the 31-board scoped native manifest. The 88-member manifest parses with 88 distinct non-traversing relative paths and matches its recorded member count (not an independent recomputation of media SHA-256). The PR's 559 changed paths include 558 within F02 and one shared `SESSION_RETURNS.md` path.

**Scoped semantic finding: source policy is coherent.** Candidate.2 continuous gutter/rail/overlay geometry and candidate.4 ownership/Brain/focus concurrence match the existing F01 source contract. The corrected focus language conditions restoration on actual retiring-surface ownership and preserves intentional subsequent focus. Brain Close is not Stop, open/mounted is not visible, one modal owns Escape, and the D06 focused-reader/price-plot dimensions are distinct from the shared inspector. F02 documents the true `32 boards / 31 complete native pairs / 640 dispatches / 639 observed applies / 1 EFFECT_UNKNOWN` state, retains 67 originals and 20 tokens by its existing same-carrier receipt, and expressly excludes the Chinese comparison from the scoped review. This is source-consistency checking, **not** a separate visual review, executed browser proof, cryptographic media rehash or native-state attestation.

**Material integration finding — reconcile the parent-owned shared ledger before any integration.** The F02 head contains `SESSION_RETURNS.md` blob `d0b7a982e169101a57252e3427f3aef5243c23f4`, with only F02 marked progressing and **P00/F01/F03/D02/D03/D06/D07/D08 still `NOT_STARTED`**. The existing programme parent [#10617](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/pull/10617) at `a1676c9d59b38936527cdade2531f11e7a5e07e7` has this same file at blob `9c8ca8a3fdaf6efb1692b12352cdd0a4e9003c4e`, reconciling **9 verified returns / 27 unverified assignments**. The F02 PR is based on `main`, not the parent head; its old whole-file view must not overwrite the parent’s eight other reconciled returns or reclassify them as unlaunched. **Action for existing F02 and programme owners:** on the current carriers, reconcile this one shared-path delta against the parent-owned ledger, preserve all nine verified rows and the latest F02 state, and produce an exact-base integration diff before release. Do not add a second ledger, duplicate a session/reviewer, or change a held PR's Ready/queue/label state.

**Small source-navigation correction in the same existing F02 pass.** `SOURCE_AND_DATA_CONTRACT.md` still labels its top section “Current continuation status — NATIVE_WRITES_PAUSED_EFFECT_UNRESOLVED” and narrates the historical 22-board/435-dispatch/50-binding checkpoint. Current `RETURN_F02.md` and `paper/NATIVE_CONTINUATION_20261104.md` clearly supersede it. Date and mark that paragraph **historical/superseded**, or update it to the 32-board scoped state, to prevent a future builder from mistaking completed disjoint repairs for work to relaunch.

**Preserved gates:** operation `f02-c2-macro-light-zh-390-chart-footer-20261103-01` remains EFFECT_UNKNOWN on the original Paper carrier; no replay or replacement. Neither this review nor the source-policy concurrence clears the missing Chinese full-board capture, independent Product/Taste disposition, F01 native holds, formal reviewer-class/RIG admission, domain/Brain/host integration, real keyboard/touch/zoom/locale proof, implementation/deployment, or PR release. No source edits or Paper operations were performed by this reviewer.

**Disposition: SOURCE-POLICY CHECK PASSES WITH EXPLICIT INTEGRATION CORRECTIONS; PR-WIDE APPROVAL WITHHELD.** This is a real non-author COMMENT review answering the already pending request, not an additional commission or release approval.
